name: Custom Threat Campaign
description: A highly customized attack campaign that combines supply chain compromise, insider threat indicators, and advanced evasion techniques. The attacker has modified legitimate software to include a backdoor.
objective: Identify the compromised software, trace the supply chain attack, detect insider threat indicators, and fully remediate the environment.

events.message: Build server: internal tool DevToolsHelper.exe modified — unexpected code changes detected in build pipeline
27 workstations beaconing to 104.18.22.200 after deploying DevToolsHelper update — backdoor activated
Employee dev_contractor01 accessed sensitive R&D files outside working hours — possible insider threat or compromised account
Automated data collection: DevToolsHelper.exe harvesting browser credentials, SSH keys, and API tokens from all hosts

hints: Check the build pipeline for unauthorized code modifications
A software update that causes mass C2 beaconing is a supply chain attack
Investigate the contractor account for insider threat or credential compromise
All systems with the compromised software must be remediated
